propositions: alert_store.is_deduped checks if now - rec.get('timestamp_ns', 0) <= 24h window, but records built by BindingRepository.alert and other callers lack timestamp_ns, causing ts to default to 0 and the check to always return False
every pass over a corrupt bindings-retired.json appends a duplicate binding-retired-file-corrupt record because the dedup suppression never fires

alert_store.append must centrally stamp timestamp_ns on records when absent, allowing caller-supplied values to override (winning via spread-last), so all existing stampers remain unchanged and only unstamped paths gain the field
deduped alerts within the 24h window must not append duplicate records, while alerts outside the window must still append to avoid silencing genuinely recurring conditions indefinitely
legacy persisted records without timestamp_ns must remain readable without throwing exceptions, as is_deduped already uses rec.get('timestamp_ns', 0) safely
